         if activeWindowTween == tw1 then
                activeWindowTween = nil
            end
            setMainGlowEnabled(false)
            task.defer(function()
                Main.Visible = false
            end)
            MainScale.Scale = 1
            Main.BackgroundTransparency = 0
            windowTweenBusy = false
        end)
    end

    ToggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if ToggleButton:GetAttribute("IsCapsule") and capsuleLastRelX < 42 then
            return
        end

        if toggleEyesOnClick then
            toggleEyesOnClick()
        end

        for _, entry in ipairs(logoLayers) do
            if entry.onClick then pcall(entry.onClick) end
        end

        if uiVisible then
            hideMainWindow()
        else
            local _iconD  = IconCatalog.Icons[SavedConfig.SelectedLogoIcon or "ClassicYinYang"]
            local _clickS = _iconD and _iconD.ClickSound
            local _urlAsset = _clickS and resolveLogoClickSound(SavedConfig.SelectedLogoIcon or "ClassicYinYang", _clickS, false)
            if _urlAsset then
                playSound(_urlAsset, _clickS.Volume or 0.6)
            elseif _clickS and type(_clickS.Id) == "string" and _clickS.Id ~= "" then
                playSound(_clickS.Id, _clickS.Volume or 0.6)
            else
                playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.6)
            end
            showMainWindow()
        end
    end)

    do
        local drag = false
        local dragStart, startPos
        ToggleButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                if ToggleButton:GetAttribute("IsCapsule") then
                    local _relX = input.Position.X - ToggleButton.AbsolutePosition.X
                    if _relX >= 42 then return end
                end
                if not IconoCongelado then
                    drag = true
                    dragStart = input.Position
                    startPos = ToggleButton.Position
                end
            end
        end)
        track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if drag and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                ToggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, 0, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
            end
        end))
        track(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                drag = false
            end
        end))
    end

    -- Personaje animado: dos hojas de 4 x 2, reproducidas en orden.
    local BannerFrame = mk("Frame", {
        Name = "BannerSlideshow", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -83, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 38),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, ClipsDescendants = false, ZIndex = 8,
    }, TopBar)
    -- La ventana recorta una celda usando proporciones, independientemente de la resolución que entregue Roblox.
    local BannerViewport = mk("Frame", {
        Name = "SpriteViewport", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ClipsDescendants = true, ZIndex = 9,
    }, BannerFrame)
    local BannerSprite = mk("ImageLabel", {
        Name = "JumpSpinSprite", Size = UDim2.fromScale(4, 2),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = "rbxassetid://95331276484866",
        ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch, ZIndex = 9,
    }, BannerViewport)
    local BannerSheets = {"rbxassetid://95331276484866", "rbxassetid://98784763318607"}
    local function bannerFrame(index)
        local localIndex = index % 8
        local col, row = localIndex % 4, math.floor(localIndex / 4)
        local image = BannerSheets[math.floor(index / 8) + 1]
        if BannerSprite.Image ~= image then BannerSprite.Image = image end
        BannerSprite.Position = UDim2.fromScale(-col, -row)
    end
    bannerFrame(0)
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok, provider = pcall(function() return game:GetService("ContentProvider") end)
        if ok and provider then pcall(function() provider:PreloadAsync(BannerSheets) end) end
    end)
    task.spawn(function()
        while BannerFrame and BannerFrame.Parent do
            if PerfOpt.Flags.NoDecorAnim then
                bannerFrame(0)
                BannerViewport.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
                task.wait(0.5)
            else
                task.wait(0.65)
                for index = 0, 15 do
                    if not BannerFrame.Parent then return end
                    if PerfOpt.Flags.NoDecorAnim then break end
                    bannerFrame(index)
                    local jump = math.sin(math.pi * index / 15) * 5
                    BannerViewport.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, -jump)
                    task.wait(0.09)
                end
                bannerFrame(0)
                BannerViewport.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
            end
        end
    end)

        Boom.Ring.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, base),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.34, base),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.46, alt),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)),

            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, base),

        Boom.Icon.ImageColor3 = getContrastColor(Theme.Accent)
    end

                    for _, bar in ipairs(bars) do
                        TweenService:Create(bar, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, math.random(25, 100) / 100, 0)}):Play()
                    end
                end
                task.wait(playing and 0.18 or 0.5)
            end
        end)
    end

    local function playBoombox(id)
        if BoomboxSound then
            pcall(function() BoomboxSound:Stop() BoomboxSound:Destroy() end)
            BoomboxSound = nil
        end
        if not id or id == "" then return end
        local cleanId = id:match("%d+")
        if not cleanId then return end
        pcall(function()
            local s = Instance.new("Sound")
            s.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. cleanId
            s.Volume = 0.8
            s.Looped = true
            s.Parent = workspace
            s:Play()
            BoomboxSound = s
            print("Boombox: reproduciendo " .. cleanId)
        end)
    end

    BoomboxInput.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        local text = BoomboxInput.Text:gsub("%s+", "")
        if text == "" then
            if BoomboxSound then
                pcall(function() BoomboxSound:Stop() BoomboxSound:Destroy() end)
                BoomboxSound = nil
            end
            BoomboxPlaceholder.Visible = true
        else
            playBoombox(text)
        end
    end)

            "Yin Yang Creator Nick",
            "Report any bugs",
            "Remember to join the discord",

        }

        local SubText = mk("TextLabel", {
            Name = "RotatingSubText", Parent = Main,
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(0.72, 0, 0, 17),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 38),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = SUBTEXT_MESSAGES[1],

        SubText.TextColor3 = Theme.SubText or Theme.Accent

        local subShine = mk("UIGradient", {

                task.wait(10)

                    TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
                    { TextTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 34) }
                ):Play()
                task.wait(0.32)
                if not SubText or not SubText.Parent then break end
                subtextIdx = (subtextIdx % #SUBTEXT_MESSAGES) + 1
                SubText.Text = SUBTEXT_MESSAGES[subtextIdx]
                SubText.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 42)
                TweenService:Create(SubText,
                    TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                    { TextTransparency = 0, Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 38) }
                ):Play()
            end
        end)
    end

    local isMaximized = false
    local normalWindowSize = Main.Size
    local normalWindowPosition = Main.Position
    local normalWindowAnchorPoint = Main.AnchorPoint
    local hiddenSiblingStates = {}
    local closingUI = false

    local function setRobloxCoreVisible(visible)
        local coreTypes = {
            Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack,
            Enum.CoreGuiType.Chat,
            Enum.CoreGuiType.Health,
            Enum.CoreGuiType.PlayerList,
            Enum.CoreGuiType.EmotesMenu,
        }
        for _, coreType in ipairs(coreTypes) do
            pcall(function()
                StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(coreType, visible)
            end)
        end
        pcall(function()
            StarterGui:SetCore("TopbarEnabled", visible)
        end)
    end

    local function setOtherScreenObjectsVisible(visible)
        if not visible then
            hiddenSiblingStates = {}
            for _, child in ipairs(ScreenGui:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child ~= Main and child ~= ShadowFrame then
                    hiddenSiblingStates[child] = child.Visible
                    child.Visible = false
                end
            end
        else
            for child, wasVisible in pairs(hiddenSiblingStates) do
                if child and child.Parent then
                    child.Visible = wasVisible
                end
            end
            hiddenSiblingStates = {}
        end
    end

    local function applyMaximizedState(maximized)
        if closingUI or isMaximized == maximized then return end
        isMaximized = maximized

        if maximized then
            normalWindowSize = Main.Size
            normalWindowPosition = Main.Position
            normalWindowAnchorPoint = Main.AnchorPoint

            ShadowFrame.Visible = false
            setOtherScreenObjectsVisible(false)
            setRobloxCoreVisible(false)

            Main.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
            Main.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-3, -3)
            Main.Size = UDim2.new(1, 6, 1, 6)
            MainScale.Scale = 1

            local mainCorner = Main:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
            if mainCorner then mainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 0) end
            local topCorner = TopBar:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
            if topCorner then topCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 0) end
        else
            setRobloxCoreVisible(true)
            setOtherScreenObjectsVisible(true)

            Main.AnchorPoint = normalWindowAnchorPoint
            Main.Position = normalWindowPosition
            Main.Size = normalWindowSize

            local mainCorner = Main:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
            if mainCorner then mainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10) end
            local topCorner = TopBar:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
            if topCorner then topCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10) end
            ShadowFrame.Visible = uiVisible
        end
    end

    local uiHidden = false
    local function hideUI()
        if uiHidden then
            uiHidden = false
            uiVisible = true
            Main.Visible = true
            ShadowFrame.Visible = true
            setRobloxCoreVisible(false)
            return
        end
        uiHidden = true
        uiVisible = false
        Main.Visible = false
        ShadowFrame.Visible = false
        setRobloxCoreVisible(true)
    end

    local function shutdownUI()
        if closingUI then return end
        closingUI = true

        setRobloxCoreVisible(true)
        if globalConnections.ShaderRestore then pcall(globalConnections.ShaderRestore) end
        if BoomboxSound then
            pcall(function() BoomboxSound:Stop() BoomboxSound:Destroy() end)
            BoomboxSound = nil
        end
        for _, conn in ipairs(globalConnections) do
            pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
        end
        pcall(function() dragonConnection:Disconnect() end)
        pcall(function() ScreenGui:Destroy() end)
        if Window and type(Window.OnClose) == "function" then
            pcall(Window.OnClose)
        end
    end

    local WindowControls = mk("Frame", {
        Name = "WindowControls",
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
        Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 17),
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 30),

        VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,

        SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,

    local function createWindowControl(name, imageId, order, tooltip)
        local button = mk("ImageButton", {
            Name = name,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(imageId),
            ImageColor3 = Theme.WindowIcon,
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            LayoutOrder = order,
            ZIndex = 51,
        }, WindowControls)
        button:SetAttribute("ThemeImageRole", "WindowIcon")
        button:SetAttribute("DefaultImage", "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(imageId))
        button:SetAttribute("Tooltip", tooltip)

        local scale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, button)
        corner(button, 999)
        button.BackgroundColor3 = name == "Close" and Color3.fromRGB(232, 17, 35) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(button, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {BackgroundTransparency = name == "Close" and 0.15 or 0.86}):Play()
        end)
        button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(button, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
        end)
        button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.08), {Scale = 0.82}):Play()
            end
        end)
        button.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
            end
        end)
        return button
    end

    function GlobalSearch.UpdateSize()
        local viewport = ScreenGui.AbsoluteSize
        if viewport.X <= 0 or viewport.Y <= 0 then return end
        local width = math.min(500, math.max(290, viewport.X - 24))
        local height = math.min(500, math.max(300, viewport.Y - 24))
        GlobalSearch.Panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
    end
    track(ScreenGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(GlobalSearch.UpdateSize))
    GlobalSearch.UpdateSize()

    function GlobalSearch.ClearResults()
        for _, child in ipairs(GlobalSearch.Results:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("GuiButton") then
                child:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end

    function GlobalSearch.Refresh()
        GlobalSearch.ClearResults()
        local query = string.lower((GlobalSearch.Box.Text or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""))
        if query == "" then
            GlobalSearch.Empty.Text = GetText("Escribe para buscar una función", "Type to search for a feature")
            GlobalSearch.Empty.Visible = true
            return
        end

        local matches = {}
        for _, entry in ipairs(Window._GlobalOptionRegistry or {}) do
            local nameES = string.lower(tostring(entry.NameSpanish or ""))
            local nameEN = string.lower(tostring(entry.NameEnglish or ""))
            local tabES = string.lower(tostring(entry.Tab and entry.Tab.NameSpanish or ""))
            local tabEN = string.lower(tostring(entry.Tab and entry.Tab.NameEnglish or ""))
            local score = nil
            for _, value in ipairs({nameES, nameEN, tabES, tabEN}) do
                if value ~= "" then
                    local found = string.find(value, query, 1, true)
                    if found then
                        local candidate = found == 1 and 0 or 1
                        score = score == nil and candidate or math.min(score, candidate)
                    end
                end
            end
            if score ~= nil then
                table.insert(matches, {entry = entry, score = score})
            end
        end

        table.sort(matches, function(a, b)
            if a.score ~= b.score then return a.score < b.score end
            return string.lower(tostring(a.entry.NameSpanish or "")) < string.lower(tostring(b.entry.NameSpanish or ""))
        end)

        GlobalSearch.Empty.Visible = #matches == 0
        if #matches == 0 then
            GlobalSearch.Empty.Text = GetText("No encontramos esa función", "No matching feature found")
            return
        end

        for index = 1, math.min(#matches, 20) do
            local entry = matches[index].entry
            local result = mk("TextButton", {
                Parent = GlobalSearch.Results,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 62),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.12,
                Text = "",
                AutoButtonColor = false,
                LayoutOrder = index,
                ZIndex = 1003,
            })
            result:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
            corner(result, 9)
            stroke(result, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.62)

            local resultIconFrame = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = result,
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 38),
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 12),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.10,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ZIndex = 1004,
            })
            resultIconFrame:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
            corner(resultIconFrame, 10)
            stroke(resultIconFrame, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.68)

            local resultIcon = mk("ImageLabel", {
                Parent = resultIconFrame,
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20),
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(9, 9),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Image = entry.Icon or (entry.Tab and entry.Tab.IconAsset) or "rbxassetid://83456197177232",
                ImageColor3 = Theme.Text,
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                ZIndex = 1005,
            })

            local resultTitle = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = result,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -116, 0, 22),
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 8),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = GetText(entry.NameSpanish, entry.NameEnglish),
                TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextSize = 13,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                ZIndex = 1004,
            })
            resultTitle:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")

            local tabName = entry.Tab and GetText(entry.Tab.NameSpanish, entry.Tab.NameEnglish) or GetText("General", "General")
            local resultMeta = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = result,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -116, 0, 16),
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 32),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = tabName .. "  ·  " .. tostring(entry.Kind or "Feature"),
                TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
                TextSize = 10,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                ZIndex = 1004,
            })
            resultMeta:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "TextDim")

            local resultArrow = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = result,
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 62),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, -38, 0, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = "›",
                TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextSize = 24,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
                ZIndex = 1004,
            })
            resultArrow:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "TextDim")

            result.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                TweenService:Create(result, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.02}):Play()
                TweenService:Create(resultArrow, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {TextColor3 = Theme.Accent}):Play()
            end)
            result.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                TweenService:Create(result, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.12}):Play()
                TweenService:Create(resultArrow, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim}):Play()
            end)
            result.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                if entry.Tab and entry.Tab.Select then
                    GlobalSearch.SetOpen(false)
                    entry.Tab.Select()
                    task.defer(function()
                        if entry.Holder and entry.Holder.Parent and entry.Tab.Page then
                            local y = entry.Holder.AbsolutePosition.Y - entry.Tab.Page.AbsolutePosition.Y + entry.Tab.Page.CanvasPosition.Y - 8
                            entry.Tab.Page.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.max(0, y))
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    function GlobalSearch.SetOpen(open)
        GlobalSearch.Open = open
        GlobalSearch.Overlay.Visible = open
        if open then
            GlobalSearch.UpdateSize()
            GlobalSearch.Refresh()
            task.defer(function()
                pcall(function() GlobalSearch.Box:CaptureFocus() end)
            end)
        else
            GlobalSearch.Box:ReleaseFocus()
        end
    end

    GlobalSearch.Backdrop.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        GlobalSearch.SetOpen(false)
    end)
    GlobalSearch.Close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        GlobalSearch.SetOpen(false)
    end)
    GlobalSearch.Box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(GlobalSearch.Refresh)
    GlobalSearch.Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.6)
        GlobalSearch.SetOpen(not GlobalSearch.Open)
    end)

    MinimizeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.6)
        if isMaximized then applyMaximizedState(false) end
        hideMainWindow()
    end)

    MaximizeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.6)
        applyMaximizedState(not isMaximized)
    end)

    CloseButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.6)
        shutdownUI()
    end)

    if title_text and (string.find(title_text, "Yin") or string.find(title_text, "Yang")) then
        local animValue = 0
        local animSpeed = 0.3
        local origColor = TitleLabel.TextColor3
        
        track(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if PerfOpt.Flags.NoDecorAnim then return end
            animValue = (animValue + animSpeed) % 360
            
            local sine = 0.6 + 0.4 * ((math.sin(math.rad(animValue)) + 1) / 2)
            
            if string.find(title_text, "Yin Yang") or string.find(title_text, "yin yang") then
                TitleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(
                    (Theme.TitleText or Theme.Accent).R * sine,
                    (Theme.TitleText or Theme.Accent).G * sine,
                    (Theme.TitleText or Theme.Accent).B * sine
                )
            else
                TitleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(
                    (Theme.TitleText or Theme.Accent).R * sine,
                    (Theme.TitleText or Theme.Accent).G * sine,
                    (Theme.TitleText or Theme.Accent).B * sine
                )
            end
        end))
    end

    do
        local drag = false
        local dragStart, startPos
        TopBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) and not isMaximized then
                drag = true
                dragStart = input
